fields.name: primary_components
fields.rationale: The dataset explicitly lists the primary components of the dispersion-based tile adhesive, which are crucial for understanding its material properties.
evidence: The dispersion-based tile adhesives consist of approximately the following components: Plastic dispersion (53.9 %), lime (5 %), water (15 %), triethylene glycol ester (12.5 %), colourants (12.5 %), dispersing agent (1 %), preservative (<1 %).

fields.name: application
fields.rationale: The dataset specifies the technical purpose of the product, which is essential for categorizing its functional use.
evidence: Dispersion-based tile adhesives are used for bonding ceramic tiles and slabs as well as natural stone to walls, floors and ceilings for indoor and outdoor use.
